q.en: Which Indian leader wrote 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'?
q.as: কোন ভাৰতীয় নেতাই 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' লিখিছিল?

explanation.en: Dadabhai Naoroji's 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' explained the drain of wealth.
explanation.as: দাদাভাই নৌৰজীৰ 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India'এ সম্পদ নিষ্কাশন বৰ্ণনা কৰিছিল।
